title: epan: Optimize the duplicate Decode As preference check
description:
Rather than checking every dissector handle added for Decode As to
an integer table for possible automatic preference collision, only
check it for dissector handles that are actually getting automatic
preferences. In fact, only check it on collision when registering.

commits_data.message:
epan: Optimize the duplicate Decode As preference check

Rather than checking every dissector handle added for Decode As to
an integer table for possible automatic preference collision, only
check it for dissector handles that are actually getting automatic
preferences. In fact, only check it on collision when registering.
